Container.Name: SlickdealsTracker
Container.Overview: Monitor Slickdeals.net for deals matching your configured categories (TVs, laptops, SSDs, gaming, and more). Sends Pushover push notifications for great deals and includes a web dashboard to browse tracked deals. Supports hot-deal frontpage monitoring across all categories.

Config.Name: Config & Data Path
Config.Description: Stores config.yaml and deals.db. A default config.yaml is created on first run.

Config.Name: Web Dashboard Port
Config.Description: Port for the Slickdeals Tracker web dashboard.

Config.Name: Pushover API Token
Config.Description: Your Pushover application API token. Get one at pushover.net.

Config.Name: Pushover User Key
Config.Description: Your Pushover user key (shown on the Pushover dashboard).

Config.Name: Enable Pushover Notifications
Config.Description: Set to true to enable push notifications via Pushover.

Config.Name: Enable Hot Deals Monitor
Config.Description: Monitor Slickdeals frontpage for hot deals across ALL categories.

Config.Name: Hot Deals Min Score
Config.Description: Minimum community vote count for hot deals. 0 = trust frontpage curation.

Config.Name: Poll Interval (minutes)
Config.Description: How often to check Slickdeals for new deals.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Your timezone, e.g. America/Chicago, America/Los_Angeles, Europe/London.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID the container runs as. UnRAID default is 99 (nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID the container runs as. UnRAID default is 100 (users).
